title: UAP Gerb ties Elizondo to ISA/Gray Fox and the legacy program
summary: Jesse Michels tells of UAP Gerb ties Elizondo to ISA/Gray Fox and the legacy program, about unspecified at Joint Special Operations Command, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: He kind of notes that um you know intelligence support activity uh and gray fox which do recon in super sensitive situations in areas before JOCK does but it's part of joint special operations command you know that Lou was a part of that

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that an online researcher who goes by UAP Gerb links Lou Elizondo, a former Pentagon official who speaks publicly about UFOs, to the Intelligence Support Activity, also called Gray Fox. Michels describes that as a secret unit that scouts very sensitive places before other forces go in, part of Joint Special Operations Command, the military's command for its most secret special forces. The idea is that this background would tie Elizondo to a long-running secret program said to handle unexplained craft.
